Intro title: One place to query the whole Data Space
Intro text: Data Space gathers files uploaded to MinIO and data collected from external APIs. Source Connector keeps them synchronised and Query Engine indexes them, so everything can be searched from this page, whatever the original source. Pick the mode that fits your question with the tabs below:
Intro tagline: Search files uploaded to MinIO and data collected from external APIs, in four different ways.
Intro mode simple: Type a word or a value and get every file that contains it. The quickest way to find out what's there.
Intro mode advanced: Filter objects by key/value pairs, as text or as a date range, on CSV, JSON or GeoJSON files. Keys and values are suggested as you type.
Intro mode sql: Write SQL against the PostgreSQL tables of the Data Space (e.g. sources) for precise selections, joins and nested fields.
Intro mode graphql: Ask for exactly the fields you need from datapoints and sources, with suggestions from the schema. Read-only: queries only.
Intro visibility: The selector at the top decides whose data you search: private (your own), shared (shared with your pilot) or public. Results appear below the search panel.
